boundary: This amendment corrects what the completed numbers are called. It does not re-measure, re-derive, promote, demote or replace any of them, and it turns no historical GO into a new numerical verdict.
name: l33_l40_validated_band_followup_report

terminology_changes.reason: the field reports an argmax over two supplied candidates. Anthropic's trial definition inspects the complete next-token distribution and counts success only at global rank 1, so the two are not comparable and the name asserted that they were

terminology_changes.corrected_wording: restricted-candidate preference at alpha=1: the target answer outranks the other predeclared candidate by teacher-forced conditional sequence likelihood
terminology_changes.original_wording: Anthropic's top-1 trial definition at alpha=1
terminology_changes.reason: the criterion never consulted any vocabulary row outside the two supplied answers

terminology_changes.corrected_wording: fraction of trials in which the target-appropriate downstream answer is top-1 of the externally scored candidate set [restricted-candidate endpoint; the full vocabulary was not evaluated]
terminology_changes.original_wording: fraction of trials in which the target-appropriate downstream answer is top-1 of the externally scored candidate set
terminology_changes.reason: the wording was already accurate but was read as a global top-1 rate; the qualifier is now explicit
the verdict string is immutable and is reproduced verbatim; the endpoint labels are added beside it, not substituted for it
`target_rank` was a rank among the two scored candidates, not a rank in the vocabulary
